description: Create a professional performance review rebuttal document. You received a review with two inaccurate criticisms: (1) 'Employee rarely participated in team meetings (attended less than 50% of weekly standups Q3-Q4)' and (2) 'Missed deadline for Vendor Integration Project by 2 weeks without communication'. Open /home/ga/Documents/TextDocuments/Performance_Review_Rebuttal.docx and complete it by: (1) Adding section headers for each criticism with bold formatting, (2) Creating an evidence table showing meeting attendance dates (at least 8 rows with columns: Date, Meeting Type, Attended), (3) Writing specific responses to each criticism, (4) Adding a professional closing statement. Save the document (Ctrl+S).
